title: The Same Door Twice
text: A damaged traveler journal records: A portal opens onto both sides of the same corridor, but travelers return carrying different memories.

title: Stars Underfoot
text: An old field report states: The lights below are not reflections; several respond when addressed by forgotten constellation names.

title: Borrowed Yesterday
text: A local record preserves this account: A physical memory of rainfall persists in one chamber despite the Astral Sea never having weather there.

title: The Folded Mile
text: An unsigned observation reads: Surveyors walked one hundred steps forward and returned behind their starting marker.

title: Please Ignore Future Me
text: A page in Shizuki's familiar handwriting says: Shizuki wrote: "If another version of me says this sign is safe, ask which one touched it first."

title: Continuance Route
text: An old field report states: Facility traffic records converge here from annexes separated by distance, politics, and nearly a century.

title: Memory Coral
text: A local record preserves this account: The coral grows scenes instead of branches and sheds them when someone recognizes the people depicted.

title: Portal Etiquette
text: An unsigned observation reads: Old Fae instructions advise greeting a doorway before asking where it leads.

title: The Missing Minute
text: A damaged traveler journal records: Every clock loses the same minute near the central convergence, though witnesses remember spending hours inside it.

title: Terminal Name Updated
text: A page in Shizuki's familiar handwriting says: Shizuki renamed the central terminal "Definitely_Not_Shizuki.txt" and replaced its alert tone with applause.

title: Subject Index Fragment
text: A local record preserves this account: Entries One through Six end in failure codes; Subject Seven's result field redirects to a sealed project file.

title: Architecture in Reverse
text: An unsigned observation reads: One structure is assembled from its roof downward while foundations appear only after rooms are entered.

title: The Other Ocean
text: A damaged traveler journal records: A portal briefly shows an Astral Sea with no Moonlit Reef and a different arrangement of stars.

title: Century Counter
text: An old field report states: A project clock measures from the original escape rather than from the facility's construction.

title: Emotionally Out of Order
text: A page in Shizuki's familiar handwriting says: Shizuki's label on a security construct reads: "Technically functional. Spiritually having a difficult day."

title: Convergence Law
text: An unsigned observation reads: Objects from all six regions drift toward the Nexus but stop before touching, held in a permanent almost-collision.

title: White-Haired Figure
text: A damaged traveler journal records: A damaged memory projection shows someone kneeling beside a small elf, but the face and spoken name are missing.

title: Portal Root
text: An old field report states: Living Fae roots pass through sealed geometry without puncturing it, connecting rooms that cannot share space.

title: The Viability Question
text: A local record preserves this account: Researchers repeatedly ask why Seven survived procedures that killed or destabilized earlier subjects.

title: Helpful Future Warning
text: A page in Shizuki's familiar handwriting says: Shizuki wrote: "Do not enter the blue portal until yesterday. You will understand later, unfortunately."

title: Replacement Personnel
text: A damaged traveler journal records: Staff records continue through descendants, constructed bodies, and unexplained identity transfers.

title: The Kindness Gap
text: An old field report states: Several records were removed by someone with authorized access immediately after Subject Seven received a personal name.

title: Central Objective
text: A local record preserves this account: The project sought a stable living connection among Fae magic, memory, and Astral currents, but its intended use is redacted.

title: A Room Remembering Shizuki
text: An unsigned observation reads: The chamber recreates an empty berry pouch and laughter, evidence of a later visit made freely.

title: Access Card With Doodles
text: A page in Shizuki's familiar handwriting says: Shizuki returned an executive card covered in stars and wrote: "Your security remains adorable."

title: Timeline Scar
text: An old field report states: One corridor contains overlapping evacuation alarms from events separated by eighty-three years.

title: The Unresolved Name
text: A local record preserves this account: A file confirms someone named Subject Seven but removes every clue identifying that person.

title: Continuance Directive
text: An unsigned observation reads: The organization ordered all surviving annexes to send results here even after their original leaders disappeared.

title: Why Seven Endured
text: A damaged traveler journal records: The answer field is intact but encrypted by a Fae pattern that changes whenever it is observed.

title: The Open Convergence
text: A page in Shizuki's familiar handwriting says: The final record promises a next phase beyond the Nexus while leaving its architects and purpose unknown.
